subject: Eval kit delivery & usage constraints — proposed roadmap
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Eval kit delivery & usage constraints — proposed roadmap

Hi Priya —

Following our call this morning, attaching a proposed timeline and the initial eval materials we discussed. The delivery is packaged as: prompt pack (prompt templates + guardrail rules), a small set of masked test cases (100 examples), and a readme with pass/fail criteria.

Key asks from Acme so we can ship Monday:
- Confirm any extra NDAs / redlines on data-use (specifically: no public redistribution, 30-day retention window for logs).
- Confirm point-of-contact for test-case feedback (name + email).
- Accept the MAP milestones below so we can reserve dedicated pool time for weekend runs.

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
- Day 0 (Mon 11/23): Deliver prompt pack + sample testcases (attached).
- Day 1–2: Smoke runs by Acme, tag failures and quality notes in shared doc.
- Day 3: Redwood runs full pass on dedicated pool, returns metrics + sample outputs.
- Day 5: Joint review; if pass threshold met we move to short pilot (1 wk).

Usage & licensing summary (short):
- Redwood provides the eval kit to Acme for internal evaluation only. No redistribution to third parties.
- Allowed uses: internal model validation, benchmark runs against ACME use-cases.
- Prohibited: publishing the prompt pack or testcases, commercial re-use of the testcases.

Attachments: acme_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (prompt templates + constraint spec), sample_testcases.jsonl (100 masked records), MAP_timeline_v2.xlsx (deliverable dates).

If this looks good I can send a one-page MAP + one-page Data Use Exhibit for signature.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

From: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeretail.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Retail Platform Team <acme-ml@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Eval kit delivery & usage constraints — proposed roadmap

Dev —

Thanks for the plan and the materials. A few quick notes from our side before you release anything into our org: 

1) Legal has asked for a concise Data Use Exhibit that clarifies: retention period for logs (we prefer 7 days for this pilot), who at Redwood can access logs, and whether we can request deletion on demand.
2) We need the prompt pack to be redacted of any Redwood-specific telemetry examples — can you confirm the ZIP has only templates and not live outputs?
3) On licensing: Acme is fine with internal evaluation only, but procurement wants a short commercial-use clause that allows us to consider a paid pilot license if the results meet thresholds (we'll provide draft language).

POC for test-case feedback is me (priya@acmeretail.com). Preferred time for joint review is Wed 11/25, afternoon PT.

If you can send the Data Use Exhibit with the 7-day retention and deletion clause plus a short MAP for signature, we'll aim to sign by EOD 11/23.

Best,
Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Platform & ML | Acme Retail
priya@acmeretail.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Eval kit delivery & usage constraints — Acme questions (internal)

Laura / Rishi —

Forwarding Priya's reply. Short checklist for legal & product: 
- Legal: prepare Data Use Exhibit with retention=7 days, on-demand deletion, and list of Redwood roles that can access logs (SRE + Solutions Eng). Also include clause: no publication or third-party transfer of testcases.
- Product: confirm prompt pack contains only templates & guardrails (no sample outputs or dev telemetry). We should strip any generated samples.
- Sales: I will update MAP to show Wed 11/25 joint review and target pilot start 11/30 if pass.

Rishi, can you confirm we can guarantee a dedicated pool slot for their weekend run (11/28–11/29)? If not, propose an alternative.

I'll assemble the one-page MAP + DUE and send to Priya for signature.

Thanks,
Dev

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeretail.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Eval kit delivery & usage constraints — proposed roadmap

Hi Priya —

Thanks — quick confirmation from Redwood legal & product below: 

- Data Use Exhibit: attached (DataUseExhibit_acme_v1.pdf). It follows your 7-day retention request and includes deletion-on-request language. We list Redwood roles with access (SRE, Solutions Eng) and add an audit log entry requirement any time logs are accessed.
- Prompt pack: Dev verified the ZIP contains only templates, guardrail rules, and pseudocode examples; no runtime outputs or telemetry.
- Dedicated pool: Rishi confirmed capacity for weekend runs (11/28–11/29). We will reserve a burst slot and notify you if anything changes.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm you accept the attached DUE & one-page MAP (I attached MAP_v1.pdf). If so, sign & return by EOD 11/23 PT and we'll start the delivery on 11/23 as planned.
2) Joint review scheduled Wed 11/25, 1:00–2:00 PT (calendar invite forthcoming).

If you want small wording tweaks to the DUE, we can do one friendly redline pass.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: DataUseExhibit_acme_v1.pdf (data retention + access), MAP_v1.pdf (milestones & sign-off)
